comments.note: User::save() calls UserCollection::create()->save() using the concrete class name, bypassing mock injection in tests. This works because tests only verify in-memory state, but it means persistence is not exercised during unit tests. A factory override or dependency injection would make this more testable.

The existing constants KEY_ID through KEY_IMAGE_BOOKMARKS lack the 'public const string' typed declaration used by the new KEY_FILTER_SETTINGS — they use the older untyped 'public const' syntax. These should be migrated to typed constants for consistency with PHP 8.4 conventions.

summary: All 6 acceptance criteria verified via code review and test execution.

Edge-case noted: getFilterSettings() uses a snapshot pattern — each call creates a new ArrayDataCollection from the raw stored array. Mutations to the returned object require an explicit setFilterSettings() round-trip to persist; this is correct by design.

comments.note: getFilterSettings() creates a new ArrayDataCollection snapshot on every call (ArrayDataCollection::create($this->filterSettings)). Consumers mutating the returned object without calling setFilterSettings() will silently discard changes. Consider documenting this in a docblock or returning a cached instance if mutation tracking is ever needed.

No test explicitly asserts that save() is invoked when setFilterSettings() is called (pre-existing architectural limitation where User::save() calls UserCollection::create() concrete class, not the mock). All ACs are provably met through in-memory state verification; this gap is acceptable for the current test infrastructure.

comments.note: assets/classes/Users/User.php: @var array<string,string> on $filterSettings (and the matching @param on the constructor) is narrower than necessary. ArrayDataCollection::getData() returns array<string,mixed>, and real-world filter values may include booleans or integers (e.g., page-limit, toggle states). Widen to array<string,mixed> to avoid PHPStan friction at higher analysis levels and to allow non-string filter values in future.

getFilterSettings() and setFilterSettings() lack docblocks. Not blocking under the project's inconsistent existing coverage, but a docblock on getFilterSettings() noting the snapshot behaviour (each call returns a new ArrayDataCollection; mutations are not persisted without an explicit setFilterSettings() round-trip) would prevent consumer confusion.

Inherited from Developer note: KEY_ID through KEY_IMAGE_BOOKMARKS still use untyped 'public const' syntax. KEY_FILTER_SETTINGS correctly uses 'public const string'. The older constants should be migrated to typed form for PHP 8.4 consistency.
